_meta.spec: MIPI SoundWire I3S (SWI3S) Specification, Version 1.1 Revision 06 (2026-05-03)
conventions: All offsets are within ONE peripheral device. Target device is selected by the 12-bit Device Mask in the Phase Header, NOT by the address. Every peripheral has the identical numeric layout (Table 163).
Region bases (Table 164): PHY1=0x100, PHY2=0x200, PHY3=0x300, SLC=0x1000, CDS=0x1100, DataPorts DP0..DP31=0x2000+0x100*n.

dual_ranked=true: listed offset is the _NEXT register; _CURR is at offset+0x40. Commit (SSCR/DSCR) copies _NEXT->_CURR; a direct write to _CURR also copies to _NEXT. _NEXT cleared only by Cold Reset; some _CURR (e.g. EnableCh) also cleared by Warm Reset.
excess1 fields: actual = stored+1 (SampleSize, SampleGrouping, Interval, HorizontalCount, BitWidth, ConverterClockDiv; NumColumns: ColumnCount=NumColumns+1).

Endianness: SLC ManufacturerID/PartID/SkippingDenominator are MSB-first (hi byte at lower addr). DP Interval/Offset/ConverterClockDiv/SkippingNumerator and FCP_Offset are LSB-first (lo byte at lower addr).
Local 0x0-0x7FFFFFFF complete in-Phase; Remote 0x80000000-0xFFFFFFFF may be buffered/deferred (Table 163).
INCONSISTENCY: DP FlowMode (0x0E[1:0]) is in the single-ranked map (Table 166) yet Table 168 marks its access 'Dual'; no _CURR address is given, so it is represented single-ranked here.

fields.name: DeviceNumber
fields.description: Static device number; indexes the Device Mask.

fields.name: PM_Action
fields.description: Peripheral Management Action (Table 20). Single-ranked but the action fires on the next SSCR/DSCR Commit; values 0x2/0x3/0x4 self-clear to Stay_Attached afterwards.

fields.name: SkippingDenominator[11:8]
fields.description: High nibble (MSB-first) of skip denominator; Optional (all 12 bits or none).

fields.name: SyncPointOffset
fields.description: Rows subtracted from Row_Delay to form Sync_Point_Delay.

fields.name: ForceRemoteFail
fields.description: Write 1 aborts outstanding remote op as failed (Conditional).

fields.name: DevStat_LostLock
fields.description: Detached due to lost clock recovery (Conditional: PHY3).

fields.name: DevStat_BadCommandConfidence
fields.description: Detached due to lost command confidence.

fields.name: IntStat_BadCRC
fields.description: CRC mismatch on a Manager/Peripheral packet.

fields.name: IntStat_AbandonedPhase
fields.description: Phase abandoned due to a new valid Header.

fields.name: IntStat_UnexpectedNewHeader
fields.description: Valid Phase Header detected during an ongoing Phase.

fields.name: IntStat_BadHD10
fields.description: Corrupted HD10 token decoded to nearest HD10.

fields.name: IntStat_CalibrationReq
fields.description: Peripheral requests a Calibration command (Conditional: PHY3).

fields.name: IntStat_Bad8b10b
fields.description: CDS word not mappable to a valid byte.

fields.name: IntStat_BadPhyCalPair
fields.description: Mismatch in R/not-R PHY-cal data (Conditional: InitCal/TrimCal).

fields.name: IntCascade_DFI<n>
fields.description: OR of interrupts from Hub DFI1..7 (bit n = DFIn). bit0 Reserved.

fields.name: IntStat_SDCA_<63:00>
fields.description: 64 SDCA interrupt-status bits across 8 bytes (0x40=SDCA07:00 ... 0x47=SDCA63:56). Conditional (SDCA).

fields.name: IntEn_SDCA_<63:00>
fields.description: Enables for the 64 IntStat_SDCA bits (8 bytes).

fields.name: IntEn_ImpDef_<31:00>
fields.description: Enables for the 32 IntStat_ImpDef bits (4 bytes).

fields.name: UI_RateRange
fields.description: Unit-interval rate range (Table 28). RO:0 on PHY1/PHY2 (0=not provided).

fields.name: RowRateRange
fields.description: Row-rate range (Table 29). 0 on PHY1/PHY2 = Manager has not provided row rate.

blocks.name: CDS
blocks.description: Control Data Stream transport (one per device). PHY-specific CDS bit placement and drive. Dual-ranked _NEXT shown; _CURR = _NEXT + 0x40 (Dual-CURR-is-RO). Tables 173/174.

fields.name: CDS_HorizontalStart
fields.description: First UI (column) in the Row used for the CDS. PHY1/2: RO 0; PHY3: writable (reset 2).

fields.name: CDS_DriveType
fields.description: 0=CDS=1 driven high-Z (bus-keeper holds) — affects NRZS decode; 1=actively driven. PHY3 mandatory, PHY1/2 optional.

fields.name: CDS_BitWidth
fields.description: UIs per CDS bit (excess-1: 0->1 UI .. 7->8 UI).

fields.name: CDS_EndDriveEarly
fields.description: Stop driving CDS 1/2 UI early (mandatory PHY3).

fields.name: CDS_GuardEnable
fields.description: Add a 1-UI guard bit after the CDS bit.

fields.name: CDS_TailWidth
fields.description: Tail UIs after the CDS (or guard) bit. PHY1: RO 0.

blocks.name: PHY1
blocks.description: PHY1 (FBCSE) electrical control (one per device). Dual-ranked _NEXT shown; _CURR = _NEXT + 0x40. Tables 176/177. NOTE: PHY selection itself (PHY1/2/3) is NOT register-visible — it is set by Cold Start LC_PHY physical signaling.

fields.name: PHY1_RiseFallTimeGRamp
fields.description: Output rise/fall time for the Conductance Ramp.

fields.name: PHY1_RiseFallTimeVRamp
fields.description: Output rise/fall time for the Voltage Ramp.

fields.name: PHY1_FirstBitRampType
fields.description: Ramp type when previous bit not owned by this device.

fields.name: PHY1_AdjBitRampType
fields.description: Ramp type between adjacent bits owned by this device.

blocks.name: PHY2
blocks.description: PHY2 (FBCSE) electrical control (one per device). Same layout as PHY1 (often aliased to the same storage). Tables 176/177.

fields.name: PHY2_RiseFallTimeGRamp
fields.description: Output rise/fall time for the Conductance Ramp.

fields.name: PHY2_RiseFallTimeVRamp
fields.description: Output rise/fall time for the Voltage Ramp.

fields.name: PHY2_FirstBitRampType
fields.description: Ramp type when previous bit not owned by this device.

fields.name: PHY2_AdjBitRampType
fields.description: Ramp type between adjacent bits owned by this device.

blocks.name: PHY3
blocks.description: PHY3 (DLV, differential low-voltage) electrical + calibration control (one per device). 0x00-0x09 single-ranked (calibration bounds); 0x80-0x88 dual-ranked (_CURR = _NEXT + 0x40). Tables 178/179/180.

fields.name: PHY3_CalibrationDelayMin
fields.description: Minimum acceptable calibration delay (used by InitCal/TrimCal).

fields.name: PHY3_RiseFallTimeGRamp
fields.description: Output rise/fall time for the G-Ramp.

fields.name: PHY3_RiseFallTimeVRamp
fields.description: Output rise/fall time for the V-Ramp.

fields.name: PHY3_CalibRampType
fields.description: Ramp type for CDS=0 bits during Calibration Measurement.

fields.name: PHY3_FirstBitRampType
fields.description: Ramp type when previous bit not owned by this device.

fields.name: PHY3_AdjBitRampType
fields.description: Ramp type between adjacent bits owned by this device.

fields.name: PHY3_CalibrationDelay
fields.description: Calibration delay result (written by Manager during InitCal/TrimCal).

blocks.name: DP
blocks.description: Data Port (one block per implemented Data Port DP0..DP31)
blocks.abs_address_note: abs_address column shows DP0 (n=0). For DPn add 0x100*n.

fields.name: IntStat_FlowControlFail
fields.description: Flow-control mismatch (Conditional: Sink DP w/ flow control).

fields.name: IntStat_TestFail
fields.description: Channel received wrong data in test mode (Conditional).

fields.name: DevStat_ReceivedSSP
fields.description: Set on any SSP indication (expected or not).

fields.name: PortSyncOK
fields.description: Interval machine synchronized (after SSP, or Interval=1 Row, or SubRowInterval=1).

fields.name: SampleSize
fields.description: Data bits per sample (a bit may span >1 UI per BitWidth).

fields.name: CommitGroupMemb
fields.description: Which Commit Groups this DP belongs to (reset = CG0 only).

fields.name: PortDirection
fields.description: Source puts data on bus; Sink reads from bus.

fields.name: SkippingNumerator[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte (LSB-first) of skip numerator; 0=no skipping (Optional, all 12 bits or none).

fields.name: FlowControlDelay
fields.description: Latency from FCP_DRQ to TxPresent (Conditional: FlowMode 2/3).

fields.name: FlowMode
fields.description: Flow-control mode. See INCONSISTENCY note in _meta.

fields.name: EC_TestFailCh<c>
fields.description: Per-channel test-fail counters c=0..15 (0x20=Ch0 .. 0x2F=Ch15). Source DP uses Ch0 for FCP_DRQ errors.

fields.name: Reserved
fields.description: Reserved (48 bytes). NOTE: dual-ranked _CURR copies of 0x00-0x2F would map here per offset+0x40 convention, but the single-ranked status/EC registers above are not dual-ranked.

fields.name: BitWidth
fields.description: UIs per data bit (wide bits). RO=0 on PHY1.

fields.name: HorizontalStart
fields.description: First owned UI (column) in any qualifying Row.

fields.name: EnableCh0
fields.description: Enable channel 0. _CURR cleared by Warm+Cold reset; _NEXT by Cold only.

fields.name: HorizontalCount
fields.description: Number of owned UIs in the Row (last col = HStart+HCount).

fields.name: TailWidth
fields.description: Tail UIs after last driven bit (Conditional: Source DP).

fields.name: Spacing
fields.description: UIs between channel groups / between sub-row intervals.

fields.name: Offset[3:0]
fields.description: Low nibble of 12-bit Offset (LSB-first; see 0x85 for [11:4]).

fields.name: Interval[3:0]
fields.description: Low nibble of 12-bit Interval (LSB-first; see 0x84 for [11:4]).

fields.name: Interval[11:4]
fields.description: Transport Interval (Rows), excess-1; [2:0] Mandatory,[11:3] Optional. Ignored if SubRowInterval=1.

fields.name: Offset[11:4]
fields.description: Rows from start of Transport Interval to start of payload; [2:0] Mandatory.

fields.name: EndDriveEarly
fields.description: Release bus 1/2 UI early (Optional, Source DP).

fields.name: ChannelGrouping
fields.description: Channels sent contiguously before inserting Spacing (Conditional).

fields.name: ConverterClockDiv[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte (LSB-first) of ADC/DAC clock divider (div by N+1) (Optional).

fields.name: ConverterClockDiv[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of converter clock divider.

fields.name: GuardEnable
fields.description: Enable 1-UI guard bit after last data bit (not scrambled) (Optional).

fields.name: EnableCh<7:1>
fields.description: Enable channels 1..7 (bit c = Channelc). _NEXT cleared Cold only; _CURR Warm+Cold.

fields.name: FCP_TailWidth
fields.description: FCP tail UIs (Conditional: Sink DP & FlowMode 2/3).

fields.name: FCP_Offset[3:0]
fields.description: Low nibble of FCP Offset (LSB-first; [11:4] at 0xA5).

fields.name: FCP_Offset[11:4]
fields.description: FCP payload start offset (same semantics as Offset).
